subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): session placement, dispatch, and worker turn routing

question: Should the repository accept the core-only milestone boundary—durable placement, RPC, and remote turn routing now, with target-bar UI and agent dispatch tooling deferred—once the blocker and real-worker proof are resolved?
rationale: The parent plan is staged, but this PR exposes a large new persisted and protocol surface without the later user-facing controls; automation cannot decide whether that intermediate product boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Keep the staged core boundary
options.body: Approve the core-only milestone after the P1 defect is fixed and full real-worker lifecycle proof is supplied, leaving UI and agent-tool work in separate focused changes.

options.title: Require a different boundary
options.body: Pause and split or expand the work only if maintainers require user-facing dispatch controls or additional handoff behavior before the new RPC and placement model can land.

recommendation.title: Keep the staged core boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the core-only milestone after the P1 defect is fixed and full real-worker lifecycle proof is supplied, leaving UI and agent-tool work in separate focused changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue, design plan, and implementation series establish the strongest available ownership signal for the milestone boundary.
